metadata.author: quant-os
metadata.rationale: 2.0x ATR SL and 3.5x ATR TP on M5 bars with 12-bar (60 min) horizon. Matches live trading SL/TP parameters so training labels are consistent with execution. The 2:3.5 ratio has positive expectancy when direction accuracy > 36.4%.
metadata.design_notes: SL=2.0x ATR provides ~1.5-2x the noise band on M5 gold (ATR 2-15). TP=3.5x ATR targets a 1.75:1 reward:risk ratio. The wider TP accommodates the asymmetric payoff profile of trend-following strategies.
